items.name: Alchemist's Fire
items.description:
Source PZO1110

You can throw a flask of alchemist's fire as a splash weapon with a range increment of 10 feet.

A direct hit deals 1d6 points of fire damage. Every creature within 5 feet of the point where the flask hits takes 1 point of fire damage from the splash. On the round following a direct hit, the target takes an additional 1d6 points of damage. items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: An improved form of leather armor, studded leather armor is covered with dozens of metal protuberances. While these rounded studs offer little defense individually, in the numbers they are arrayed in upon such armor, they help catch lethal edges and channel them away from vital spots. The rigidity caused by the additional metal does, however, result in less mobility than is afforded by a suit of normal leather armor.

items.description:
The Corsair’s Coat is a stylish, weathered leather coat designed for swashbucklers and those who live by the sea. Light enough to move freely in battle, this coat is reinforced with hidden strips of flexible metal, offering protection without restricting the wearer’s agility.
It functions as a mithral chain shirt +1

items.name: Blood Caimon Tacos
items.description:
A famous recipe from Savage Sustenance, these spicy and flavorful tacos will surprise & delight any diners!
Enjoyer of these tacos is granted the Caimon Taco Buff, which grants +20 movement on a charge attack, a 20 swim speed and the ability to charge through water, and the ability to hold one's breath for 30 minutes.

items.description:
The Bank of Besmara is a locket on a gold chain in the shape of a coin with a woman wearing a pirate hat on it. This item radiates no magic, cannot be located by any finding-spells, and receives +5 to sleight of hand checks made to hide the item while worn.

items.name: Blood Caimon Hide
items.description:
Caimon Hide Armor is Buoyant and it bestows no armor check penalty on Swim checks attempted by the wearer. 
It's smooth texture allows for smooth movement through water, granting a small swim-skill bonus.  
It is slightly lighter than conventional hide armor, and allows for greater dexterity. 
All other armor check penalties apply as normal.
